statement: Under the hypotheses of condition (i) of Theorem 1.1 and the boundary construction of Theorem 4.7, there are a contractible Stein manifold M, biholomorphic to the boundedly realizable tower P, an equivariant surjective submersion f : V → M, and an 44 equivariant holomorphic map fX : e X → M with f = fXµ. Both maps have connected fibres. Their fibres have simultaneous projective compactifications with analytic holes locally on M, after a deck translation. The normal-source fibres are normal and semialgebraically compactifiable up to biholomorphism, and fX is flat. Suppose additionally that the image Λ of the deck action on M is discrete and acts freely. Then the descended proper map X → M/Λ, its pullback to M, and every connected finite covering family of that pullback are flat and topologically locally trivial, with connected normal projective fibres. Their induced resolution families are smooth proper projective families; the resolution maps are proper, have connected point fibres, and are bimeromorphic on every fibre. The induced maps on integral degree-one cohomology are morphisms of local systems.
